meta.name: wiki-query
meta.description: Query pro-workflow wikis via SQLite FTS5 BM25 retrieval. Returns top-K passages with citations. Use when answering a question that any of the user's wikis already covers, when the user says "what does the wiki say about X", "ask wiki", "search wikis", or before drafting a new wiki page (to avoid duplication).

copy.tagline: 从工作维基中检索答案并引用来源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队有工作维基，需要快速查找已有知识。
copy.tagline_en: Retrieve answers from work wikis with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has work wikis and you need to quickly find existing knowledge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索你已有的工作维基（wiki）页面，并返回最相关的段落和来源引用。回答问题时，它会优先使用维基中的知识，避免重复编写。
howto.when: 当你问“维基上关于X怎么说”、“搜索维基”等，或回答可能已被维基覆盖的问题时触发。在编写新维基页面之前也会自动检查。

say.text: 维基上关于记忆系统怎么说？
say.note: Claude 会搜索所有维基并返回相关段落。

say.text: 搜索维基：agent-memory 中的 episodic memory
say.note: 指定维基名称进行精确搜索。

say.text: 帮我查一下维基，避免重复写新页面。
say.note: 在写新维基前检查已有内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search your existing work wikis and return the most relevant passages with source citations. It prioritizes wiki knowledge when answering questions, avoiding redundant writing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "what does the wiki say about X", "search wikis", or when answering a question that may be covered by a wiki. Also runs before drafting a new wiki page.

say_en.text: What does the wiki say about memory systems?
say_en.note: Claude searches all wikis and returns relevant passages.

say_en.text: Search wiki: agent-memory for episodic memory
say_en.note: Specify a wiki slug for targeted search.

say_en.text: Check the wiki to avoid duplicating a new page.
say_en.note: Checks existing wikis before writing a new one.
